definitions: A polymer composed of a small number of repeating monomer units, typically having a molecular weight significantly lower than that of a high polymer.
A molecule made up of a few monomer units, often exhibiting distinct properties from both individual monomers and high polymers.
examples: The synthesis yielded a low-molecular-weight oligomer.
Characterization of the low-molecular-weight oligomer was performed.
Properties of the low-molecular-weight oligomer were studied.
